content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Toledo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and degree requirements for the PMP®—they vary based on your background. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify whether your role in manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, or another Toledo-area sector meets the threshold.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. You'll earn the 35 PMI-required contact hours while learning from active certified practitioners. Our synchronous online format lets you study on your schedule without travel, ideal for working professionals at ProMedica, Owens Corning, Stellantis, or other major employers.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and work history. Pay the PMI exam fee when you submit. Granite PM Academy will provide your official course completion certificate, which you'll upload as part of your application package.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides focused exam-prep resources and practice exams to reinforce core concepts. You'll schedule your PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center—available in the Toledo area—at your convenience. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging topics before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or PMI membership activities. Staying current keeps your credential active and strengthens your competitive edge in Toledo's evolving job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
